validation.terminal_basis: Root collected; reviewer inspected clean four-export log

findings: extract inducts on actual eval result, constructs each Step from the same dispatch computation, and retains exact final pre-handler state/meter plus its last outcome. Terminal and failed-handler effects remain in the outcome, not spuriously in the successful prefix.
progress propagates stack bound/alignment through Step.sound and derives strict potential decrease from the same singleton checked run. State credits do not bypass potential accounting.
sufficient uses arbitrary Nat fuel with potential meter < fuel; a continued edge strictly reduces potential, and all other outcomes end immediately. No fixed 256-step cap or assumed success.
completes instantiates potential+1 and extracts the exact computed prefix and last outcome; none is computational exhaustion, distinct from failed, unsupported and EOF.
open_boundaries: DestinationContext, parent storage and ownerExists are explicit context inputs, not actual Python/frame extraction.
Ended includes failure, unsupported and EOF; completes is local evaluator termination, not EVM success or commitment.
Constant previous output through continued protected handlers is appropriate to this child-free supported subset; no generic foreign runtime parity claimed.
Outer failure settlement, rollback, canonical source occurrence and protocol history remain separate.
